rules.logic: XQL(EMAIL-003 BEC Executive Impersonation Display-Name Spoof) FOLLOWED_BY msft_o365 mailbox-rule change OR xdr_data endpoint activity (causality_actor_effective_username) for the same recipient GROUPED BY user_principal WITHIN 4h — a shared_entity stitch on the recipient user_principal that fuses the email impostor signal and the identity/endpoint follow-on into ONE BEC incident.
rules.name: BEC Executive Impersonation — Email to Identity Stitch
